```python
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB

# Daten
period_data = {
    "1": {"demand": 15, "setup_cost": 429, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "2": {"demand": 30, "setup_cost": 215, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "3": {"demand": 22, "setup_cost": 159, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5},
    "4": {"demand": 37, "setup_cost": 150, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "5": {"demand": 27, "setup_cost": 187, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "6": {"demand": 26, "setup_cost": 243, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "7": {"demand": 47, "setup_cost": 137, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 2},
    "8": {"demand": 42, "setup_cost": 383, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "9": {"demand": 40, "setup_cost": 366, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 3},
    "10": {"demand": 36, "setup_cost": 385, "prod_cost": 0, "holding_cost": 5}
}

capacities = {
    "1": 23, "2": 29, "3": 25, "4": 32, "5": 26,
    "6": 22, "7": 62, "8": 49, "9": 41, "10": 52
}

# Modell erstellen
model = gp.Model("Single-Item Lot-Sizing")
model.Params.OutputFlag = 0

# Variablen
periods = list(period_data.keys())
production = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="production")
setup = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.BINARY, name="setup")
inventory = model.addVars(periods, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, name="inventory")

# Zielfunktion: Gesamtkosten minimieren
model.setObjective(
    gp.quicksum(
        period_data[p]["setup_cost"] * setup[p] +
        period_data[p]["prod_cost"] * production[p] +
        period_data[p]["holding_cost"] * inventory[p]
        for p in periods
    ),
    GRB.MINIMIZE
)

# Nebenbedingungen
for i, p in enumerate(periods):
    # Nachfrage decken
    if i == 0:
        model.addConstr(production[p] == period_data[p]["demand"] + inventory[p])
    else:
        model.addConstr(production[p] + inventory[periods[i-1]] == period_data[p]["demand"] + inventory[p])
    
    # Kapazitätsbeschränkung
    model.addConstr(production[p] <= capacities[p] * setup[p])

    # Nicht-Negativität der Lagerbestände
    model.addConstr(inventory[p] >= 0)

# Modell optimieren
model.optimize()

# Ergebnisse ausgeben
production_plan = {p: int(production[p].X) for p in periods}
objective_value = model.ObjVal

result = {
    "production": production_plan,
    "objective_value": objective_value
}

import json
print(json.dumps(result))
```
